goal: Produce hello.txt containing a greeting and a name, then verify its word count

nodes.title: Write greeting
nodes.task: Create the file greeting.txt in the current working directory containing exactly the single line: Hello

nodes.title: Write name
nodes.task: Create the file name.txt in the current working directory containing exactly the single line: World

nodes.title: Concatenate
nodes.task: Concatenate greeting.txt and name.txt (each already exists) into hello.txt, joined with a single space and no trailing newline

nodes.title: Verify word count
nodes.task: Verify the word count of hello.txt. This is a read-only node: do not create, modify, or delete any file.
